recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No FHIR-12618 core follow-up is needed unless a future work group decision reopens slicing discriminator semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-12618 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for DSTU2 and asked to make ElementDefinition.slicing.discriminator explicit by splitting the old single discriminator syntax into a required type code and a restricted FHIRPath path, with documentation pointing to the syntax rules.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites SVN revision 11179, imported as git commit 3253654af7787e9b738b15f4618a2b9d02d56f7f. That commit added ElementDefinition.slicing.discriminator.type, ElementDefinition.slicing.discriminator.path, the discriminator-type code list, and rewrote the profiling discriminator guidance around type/FHIRPath pairs.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes elementdefinition as a datatype. Current source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml defines discriminator.type as 1..1 code/DiscriminatorType and discriminator.path as 1..1 string using the simple FHIRPath subset. source/profiling.html describes discriminators as type/FHIRPath pairs and source/fhirpath.html#simple defines the restricted subset and lists ElementDefinition.slicing.discriminator.path. Later related discriminator/FHIRPath issues FHIR-13711, FHIR-19612, FHIR-23035, and FHIR-27532 refined this area and are already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current specification already conveys the requested model and syntax; additional prose would be redundant rather than corrective.
